scope: Retrospective integration of named tegrastats rails over each measured API request. Includes board idle/background activity; not process-attributed, not summed across rails and not whole-device energy.
method: Mapped monotonic API request windows to wall time using the first supervisor memory sample and used request_telemetry.window_energy piecewise-linear integration. Windows require bracketing samples and no gaps over 2.5 seconds.
